# Scholia

> An interactive reader for primary-source texts — philosophical, literary,
> and historical works structured down to the sentence and aligned across
> translations. Operated by Dialogos AS (Norway).

Scholia hosts public-domain primary texts (Bible translations, Kant's
Critiques, Shakespeare, Milton, Ibsen, and more) alongside its own
translations, modernized reading editions, and scholarly annotations, plus
reader-contributed articles. Scholia's own translations and editions are
published under its community imprint, Scholia Sodalitas, which appears as
the publisher in bibliographic citations of these editions.

## Content

- [Library](https://scholia.study/): all hosted works, grouped by author
- [Sitemap](https://scholia.study/sitemap.xml): every readable page, per-book
- [Articles](https://scholia.study/articles): published reader articles

## Licensing

- [Licence](https://scholia.study/licence): the underlying primary texts are
  public domain. Scholia's own digitizations, translations, modernized
  editions, and editorial annotations are copyrighted and published under
  CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 — non-commercial sharing with attribution, no derivatives.
  Published articles are their authors' property, shared under the same
  licence. Please respect these terms when reusing content from this site.
